channel.title: Japanese Patterns Daily
channel.description: One Japanese sentence pattern a day, explained in English as a formula (A wa B desu = A is B), built up piece by piece, then used in a short dialogue with slow / normal / repeat drills and a real-Japanese news corner. Works entirely by ear. Voices: VOICEVOX:冥鳴ひまり, VOICEVOX:玄野武宏, Kokoro.

item.title: #4 私の コーヒーですか — Whose Coffee Is This?
item.description: Pattern: AのB (A no B) = A's B / the B of A Topic: at a restaurant Tip: Owner first, always. の works like English apostrophe-s: whatever comes before の owns or describes whatever comes after it. けんのケーキ is Ken's cake. Flip it to ケーキのけん and you've said 'the cake's Ken'. When English uses 'of' (the menu of the restaurant), turn it around in Japanese: みせのメニュー. Real Japanese (TV weather report): あしたのとうきょうのてんきです。 = Here is tomorrow's weather for Tokyo. (Literally: It's tomorrow's Tokyo's weather.) New words: ともだち (friend), みせ (shop / restaurant), メニュー (menu), ケーキ (cake)

item.title: #3 学生じゃないです — I'm Not a Student
item.description: Pattern: AはBじゃないです (A wa B ja nai desu) = A is not B Topic: self-introductions Tip: The negative ending じゃないです replaces です. It doesn't come after it, so never say "desu ja nai desu." And because "not" comes at the very end in Japanese, always listen to the last word to know whether a sentence is yes or no. Real Japanese (TV weather report): あしたは雨じゃないです。 = Tomorrow, it won't be rain. New words: 学生 (student), せんせい (teacher), かいしゃいん (office worker / company employee), 日本人 (Japanese person), アメリカ人 (American (person))

item.title: #2 今日は あめですか。 — Is it rainy today?
item.description: Pattern: AはBですか (A wa B desu ka) = Is A B? Topic: the weather today Tip: か is a question mark you can hear. You don't change the word order or add a separate word for 'is'. Just take any AはBです sentence and put か at the end. To answer, start with はい (yes) or いいえ (no). Real Japanese (radio host asking the weather forecaster): では、しゅうまつは はれですか。 = So then, will the weekend be sunny? New words: 今日 (today), あした (tomorrow), あめ (rain), はれ (sunny weather), くもり (cloudy weather), いいえ (no)

item.title: #1 私はコーヒーです — I'll Have Coffee
item.description: Pattern: AはBです (A wa B desu) = A is B (literally: as for A, B is it) Topic: ordering coffee at a café Tip: は (wa) means "as for" and marks the topic. It doesn't mean "equals." So 私はコーヒーです (watashi wa koohii desu) means "As for me, coffee," which is how you say "I'll have coffee." It does not mean "I am coffee." Memory trick: です (desu) is like a full stop. It always comes last and closes the sentence. Real Japanese (TV weather report): 今日、東京は晴れです。 = Today, it's sunny in Tokyo. (literally: today, as for Tokyo, it's sunny) New words: 私 (I, me), コーヒー (coffee), おちゃ (tea (green tea)), これ (this (thing near me))
